issue_context.title: kvserver: add an integration test which strobes between apply_to_all and apply_to_elastic
issue_context.body:
This issue is to add an integration test, similar to `TestFlowControl.*`, which changes the `kvadmission.flow_control_mode` cluster setting between `apply_to_elastic` and `apply_to_all` at different intervals.

The test should then also assert that writes can proceed throughout, assuming no intentional token exhaustion done by the test setup.

Jira issue: CRDB-43590

Epic CRDB-37515

review_comments:
What does this do? Is this to a) workaround the fact that we don't know exactly the size of proposals, and/or b) we want the streams to be blocked earlier without sending thousands of proposals?

Does it apply both to eval and send tokens?

a) yes and we cannot construct an exact sized proposal directly for all sizes
b) also yes, we could issue a 16 MiB write but we've observed that to be extremely flaky under stressrace due to overload affecting the test
